CompleteCodeBundle.description_en: Finalizes a code bundle after the client completes an OSS PUT operation. This operation validates the uploaded object and sets the code bundle status to ready. If CI metadata that triggers an automatic scan was provided during creation, a scanId is returned
CompleteCodeBundle.description_zh: 客户端完成 OSS PUT 后调用，校验上传对象并将代码包置为 ready；若创建时带有触发自动扫描的 CI 元数据，会返回 scanId

CreateCodeBundle.description_en: Creates a function code package in pending status and returns a pre-signed OSS PUT upload credential
CreateCodeBundle.description_zh: 创建 pending 状态代码包，并返回预签名 OSS PUT 直传凭证

CreateScan.description_en: Creates a scan task based on a code package that is ready
CreateScan.description_zh: 基于已 ready 的代码包创建扫描任务

CreateScanSbomExport.description_en: 生成 SBOM / 许可证清单的短时下载链接
CreateScanSbomExport.description_zh: 生成带出具方元数据的 SBOM / 许可证清单下载链接

DescribeProjects.description_en: Lists projects under a tenant by page, with support for fuzzy search by name or prompt
DescribeProjects.description_zh: 分页列出租户下的项目（Project），支持按名称/提示词模糊搜索

DescribeScan.description_en: Queries the details of a scan task
DescribeScan.description_zh: 查询扫描任务详细信息

DescribeScanResultsByEngine.description_en: Queries the task result list to retrieve detailed SAST or SCA results of a specific scan
DescribeScanResultsByEngine.description_zh: 查询任务结果列表的接口，用于获取某次扫描的 SAST 或 SCA 详细结果

DescribeScans.description_en: Lists scan tasks under a specified project with pagination
DescribeScans.description_zh: 扫描任务的列表查询接口，用于分页获取某个项目下的扫描记录
